candidates.name: The Intercept
candidates.rationale: Fills the hard-left/progressive-investigative gap. Currently no outlet in the roster covers DSA primary politics, Palestine policy, and anti-establishment Democratic races from the inside. The Intercept's Ryan Grim leads that beat and would surface left gap stories that MSNBC/CNN don't cover.

candidates.name: Reason
candidates.rationale: Fills the libertarian/center-right gap. Currently the center lane has only The Free Press. Reason's DSA/MAGA analysis (e.g., 'The DSA, MAGA, and the new policy nihilism') offers a non-partisan third frame that neither left nor right outlets provide. Good for correlation score triangulation.

candidates.name: Just the News
candidates.rationale: Fills the right-side investigative/primary-tracking gap. Covers conservative primaries, Senate nominations, and down-ballot races in depth. Complements Breitbart/Townhall opinion by adding reported news. Good for SC Senate, TX Senate, and AZ governor coverage.
